ov: قصة ثواني (الإنجليزية: Blind Intersections) هو فيلم دراما تم إنتاجه في لبنان وصدر في سنة 2012.
plotEn: Blind Intersections is a 2012 Lebanese drama film directed by Lara Saba. The film was selected as the Lebanese entry for the Best Foreign Language Film at the 86th Academy Awards, but it was not nominated.
